Hi Nikhil and Laura,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We're ready to start paperwork so we can align on commercial and compliance points. Attached are our procurement form and a PO template the finance team prefers. High-level asks from our side:

- Counterparty name for the invoice: VectorCloud, Inc. (EIN and address included in attachment)
- Preferred governing law: Delaware (we can be flexible if needed)
- Data residency: US-only, do you support VPC private deployment?
- SLA: 99.9% preferred, but we can discuss for initial pilot
- Billing cadence: Net 30 with a single PO for Q4 pilot (PO template attached)

We're hoping to complete signatures by the end of next week. Can you confirm who from Redwood will drive the MSA redline and the expected turnaround for a first-pass redline? Also please let us know if you need any security docs up front (SOC2 cert, DPAs, etc.).

Attachements: VectorCloud_Procurement_Form_2025.pdf, VC_PO_Template.docx
